verdict.rationale: Any online service that collects user data, including TWC's tax registration and wage-reporting applications, could publish a policy or control on AI-training use, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only registration, tax filing, and service-locator features plus endpoint probes, and none of it mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs, or a privacy policy on this topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
